title: Deleting a term writes a row and its earlier rows stay
custom_preconds:
Setup file (for Claude sessions; a tester does not need it)

Preconditions

  • You are signed in as a user with the "Admin" role, working in {Location-A}.
    For example: {Location-A} is Staging Heavy Duty - 9919.
  • A new name {Term-A}.
    For example: {Term-A} is ZZAUTOTEST S12-07 Short Lived.
  • Starting screen: the Credit Terms page (Settings, then "Credit Terms" in the Finance group) is open on the Active tab.
  • If any record above is missing, mark this test Blocked: "setup not done".
custom_steps:
1. Click "New Credit Term".
  2. Type {Term-A} in Name.
  3. Type 14 in the Days box.
  4. Click "Create Credit Term".
  5. Click the "⋯" at the right of the {Term-A} row.
  6. Click "Delete Credit Term".
  7. Click the red "Delete Credit Term" button.
  8. Click the "⋯" page menu beside "New Credit Term".
  9. Click "Audit Log".
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • Step 1: the window opens.
  • Step 2: the field shows the name as typed.
  • Step 3: the blue information line shows below the options.
  • Step 4: the toast "{Term-A} created" shows.
  • Step 5: the menu opens.
  • Step 6: the confirmation opens.
  • Step 7: the toast "{Term-A} deleted" shows.
  • Step 8: the menu opens.
  • Step 9: the newest row reads "Credit term deleted" / "{Term-A}: 14 days after the invoice date", and the earlier "Credit term created" row for {Term-A} is still there below it.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Credit terms", Confluence 963346440, version 3 (22 Oct 2026, "Renamed to Credit terms", Chris Ward), read 23 Oct 2026 · Epic SV-11638, story SV-11681 (Story 12, Credit Terms audit log)

  • S12-R3 table, deleted: “A term is deleted (Story 2: Row menu actions) | "Credit term deleted" | "{name}: {rule}"”
  • S12-E2: “A deleted term's earlier rows (created, edited, deactivated) stay in the log under its name.”

The build is not yet available to check this case against.
